evidence.quote: Previously, participant accounts could create Single-AZ OpenZFS file systems in VPCs shared with them, but could only create Multi-AZ file systems in VPCs they owned.
Amazon FSx for OpenZFS now allows you to create Multi-AZ file systems in shared VPCs within your AWS organization, making it easier for you to decentralize network and storage administration.

evidence.heading: Amazon FSx for OpenZFS now supports creating Multi-AZ file systems in shared VPCs
